Disclaimer* Bellway PLC 12 October 2026 Bellway p.l.c. Transaction in Own Shares 12 October 2026 Bellway p.l.c. ('Bellway' or the 'Group') announces that, in accordance with the terms of the share buyback programme (the 'Buyback Programme') announced on 1 September 2026, from 5 October 2026 up to and including 9 October 2026 the Group purchased the following number of ordinary shares of 12.5 pence each (the ‘Ordinary Shares') through Citigroup Global Markets Limited. Date Number of shares purchased Highest price paid (GBp) Lowest price paid (GBp) Volume weighted average price (GBp) Trading venue 5 Oct 2026 28,000 2,100.00 2,052.00 2,072.61 XLON 6 Oct 2026 29,000 2,078.00 2,028.00 2,051.28 XLON 7 Oct 2026 29,000 2,046.00 2,004.00 2,024.85 XLON 8 Oct 2026 29,000 1,992.00 1,968.00 1,979.57 XLON 9 Oct 2026 30,000 2,004.00 1,952.00 1,982.58 XLON The purchased Ordinary Shares will be cancelled. Since the announcement of the Buyback Programme on 1 September 2026, Bellway has purchased 782,308 Ordinary Shares in aggregate for cancellation. Following settlement of the above purchases and cancellation of the purchased ordinary shares, the Group's total number of ordinary shares in issue shall be 111,678,997 ordinary shares. In accordance with Article 5(1)(b) of Regulation (EU) No 596/2014 as it applies in the UK (the Market Abuse Regulation), the table below contains detailed information of the individual trades made by Citigroup Global Markets Limited on behalf of Bellway as part of the Buyback Programme.
